_comment: Bullet NEXT acceptance gates (C0.12). Proposed values; confirmed at the F0 gate.

F0.legacy_vs_orig: bit-identical recordings on every scene (same compiler and flags)
F0.compare_selftest: exact mode catches 1 ulp; tolerance mode passes it

F1.thread_determinism: identical final hash at 1, 2, 4, 8 threads on every scene, stable over 2 runs
F1.quality_vs_F0: every scene except tunnel_100 and projectile (legacy passes their walls): mean of 5 gravity variants (+0.0005*k m/s2); mean penetration and max joint drift <= legacy x 1.10 + 1 mm; energy gain <= legacy gain + 1 % of start energy + 0.5 J

FL.host_match: every scene run headless in HARFANG reaches the Lab's final hash, legacy and Bullet NEXT (at least the 16 F0 scenes)
FL.browser_match: the browser build reaches the native one-thread final hash on every scene for Bullet NEXT (next, nextf) and Jolt; legacy is reported only (system math library)
FL.check_mode: no address, undefined-behaviour or thread checker report on any scene; 100,000 random collision pairs per Bullet engine with no crash and no NaN
FL.host_profiles: bge279 reproduces the F0 goldens; blender53-rb on Blender 5.3's Bullet is bit-identical to Blender 5.3's own rigid body code
FL.recordings: playback reaches the live run's hash on every frame
